hero.title: Every donation delivered in order.
hero.desc_mobile: One standard to register, pack in homogeneous boxes with QR codes, and ship with a manifest.
hero.desc_desktop: Araguaney connects aid centers under one standard: registers items with category, batch, and expiry, packs them in homogeneous boxes with QR codes, and consolidates them into shipments with an exportable manifest.

steps.heading: From collection to shipment
steps.subtitle: Three steps, one shared language across centers

items.title: Register
items.desc: Each donated item is captured with its category, batch, and expiry date.
items.desc_short: Each item with category, batch, and expiry.

items.title: Pack
items.desc: Homogeneous boxes — one product, batch, and expiry — sealed with their QR code and label.

items.title: Ship
items.desc: Boxes are consolidated into pallets and shipments with an exportable manifest, ready for customs.

why.heading: Why Araguaney
why.subtitle: Dozens of aid centers in Mexico independently receive and send humanitarian supplies to Venezuela. Without a shared standard, it is impossible to know what is available or prepare cargo that meets international shipment requirements.

items.title: Homogeneous boxes
items.desc: Each box contains one product type, one batch, and one expiry. No mixing. QR code printed on the label.

items.title: Exportable manifest
items.desc: Each shipment generates a packing list with all boxes and pallets, ready for customs documentation.

items.title: National aggregate view
items.desc: A national dashboard shows total stock by category across all centers in real time.

items.title: No personal data
items.desc: No donor or recipient personal data is stored. Just inventory, traceable from box to shipment.

standards.heading: Standards we support
standards.subtitle: Araguaney is built on internationally recognized humanitarian standards to ensure inventory quality, traceability, and compatibility with other aid systems.

items.name: WHO
items.desc: Medicine donation guidelines: minimum 12-month shelf life, INN name, batch, and expiry required.

items.name: IFRC / ICRC
items.desc: Non-food item catalog and material codes for supply classification.

items.name: IOM
items.desc: Emergency relief item catalog with technical specifications.

items.name: UNSPSC
items.full: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code
items.desc: Universal product taxonomy for categorizing all supply types.

items.name: GS1
items.desc: Barcode and GTIN standards for item identification and traceability.

footer.tagline: The common standard for aid centers
footer.privacy: No personal data of donors or recipients. Just inventory, traceable from box to shipment.
